About MOD LUXURY

A Better Luxury Experience

At MOD LUXURY, luxury is not a badge — it is the way every detail is handled. From the moment you enquire to the moment you return the keys, our dedicated Toronto team prepares your vehicle, arranges your delivery and remains at your service throughout your journey. It is a standard our returning clients know well, and one we bring to every reservation.

  • ✓A personal, concierge-led service — every reservation is prepared individually, and every vehicle is inspected, detailed and presented to an exacting standard before it reaches you.
  • ✓Delivery across Toronto — your vehicle, brought to you in Downtown Toronto, Yorkville, Etobicoke, North York, Vaughan or at Toronto Pearson Airport (YYZ), precisely when you need it.
  • ✓Far more than rentals — a private content creation studio, professional photography & videography, and trusted automotive care, all under one roof.

Our Services

More Than Luxury. Built Around You.

For years, Toronto’s drivers, creators and brands have trusted one address for far more than a set of keys. Discover the studio, creative and automotive services that complete the MOD LUXURY experience.

Content Creation Studio

Our private studio is where brands are seen at their best — controlled professional lighting, immaculate backdrops and generous vehicle access, for campaigns, launches and content that demands a flawless finish.

Explore Service

Photography & Videography

Our photographers and filmmakers craft imagery with intent — automotive, brand, lifestyle and event work, artfully shot and expertly finished, delivered ready for your website, listings and social channels.

Automotive Services

Entrust your vehicle to technicians who treat it as their own — maintenance, diagnostics, repairs and inspections carried out with care, with a replacement vehicle from our collection available while yours is with us.
